import json, os, sys, time, tempfile, hashlib, platform, resource, subprocess, datetime
t0 = time.monotonic(); ROOT = '/home/ryan/rule30-lab'
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS, (1073741824, 1073741824))
def T(S): return S ^ ((S << 1) | (S << 2))
def P(R): return (T(1 + 2*R) - 1)//2
def U(S): return T(S) ^ 1
assert (P(0), U(0), T(0)) == (3, 1, 0)
for z in range(256): assert P(2*z+1) == 2*P(z)
OFF, SZ = 16, 48
def step(row):
    out = [0]*SZ
    for i in range(1, SZ-1): out[i] = row[i-1] ^ (row[i] | row[i+1])
    return out
def leftint(row): return sum(row[OFF-j] << j for j in range(OFF+1))
XS = [x for x in range(3, 512) if x & 3 == 3]
assert len(XS) == 128
n1010 = 0; stopbr = None
for X in XS:
    z = X >> 2
    for r1 in (0, 1):
        for r2 in (0, 1):
            f0 = [0]*SZ
            for j in range(OFF+1): f0[OFF-j] = (X >> j) & 1
            f0[OFF+1] = r1; f0[OFF+2] = r2
            f1 = step(f0); f2 = step(f1); f3 = step(f2)
            assert f0[OFF] == 1
            X1int = leftint(f1); X1f = (X >> 1) ^ (X | (X << 1))
            assert X1int == X1f and X1f == 2*P(z)
            b = f1[OFF+1]
            assert b == (1 ^ (r1 | r2))
            X2int = leftint(f2); X2f = T(X1f >> 1) ^ b
            assert X2int == X2f and X2f == (U if b == 1 else T)(P(z))
            c = [f0[OFF], f1[OFF], f2[OFF], f3[OFF]]
            assert c[1] == 0
            if c == [1, 0, 1, 0]:
                n1010 += 1
                assert (X & 15) in (7, 11)
                assert ((X >> 2) & 1) == b and ((X >> 3) & 1) == (1 - b)
            elif (X & 15) in (3, 15) and stopbr is None:
                stopbr = {'X_hex': hex(X), 'right': [r1, r2], 'centers': c}
assert n1010 > 0 and stopbr is not None
print('cases=512 n1010=%d stopbreak=%s' % (n1010, stopbr))
cpu = next((l.split(':',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/proc/cpuinfo').read().splitlines() if l.startswith('model name')), 'unknown')
src = open(__file__).read()
summary = {'box': 'X in [3,512), X=3 mod 4 (128 values) x 4 right pairs = 512 cases, no sampling', 'cases_1010': n1010, 'stops_under_1010': 0, 'stop_break_example': stopbr, 'P_double_identity_cases': 256}
